I can't give a verified exact count. This session has no code-execution tool, and checking about 2,450 candidates by hand is too error-prone to trust.

What I could establish exactly is the size of the candidate set:
- Popcount-5 numbers from 199 to 16383: 2002 (all popcount-5 numbers below 16384) minus 36 (those below 199) = 1966.
- Popcount-5 numbers from 16384 to 20000: 16384 plus a popcount-4 remainder m ≤ 3616. There are C(12,4) = 495 popcount-4 values below 4096, minus 3 that exceed 3616 (3648, 3712, 3840), giving 492.
- Total candidates: 1966 + 492 = 2458.

For a rough estimate, condition 2 (first and last digits differ) holds for about 9/10 of numbers, and condition 3 (digit-sum residue 5 mod 7) for about 1/7. That gives roughly 2458 × 0.9 / 7 ≈ 316. This is a probabilistic estimate, not an exact count, so the true value could differ by several units. Running a short enumeration script would give the exact answer.

ANSWER: 316
